notes.title: Demo update 0.4.2
notes.notes:
Another round of demo updates is live, with the UI updated to match the current state of the main game!

Features:


Added save and load, including cross-platform cloud save

Added hints



Fixes/improvements:


You can now zoom in on evidence, which is very helpful if you are playing on a smaller screen

There are lots of new small polish things such as providing better feedback when a UI element is interactable

There is now an instant text setting if you dislike "typewriter" dialogue text

notes.title: Demo update 0.4.1
notes.notes:
Another round of demo updates is live, focusing on quality-of-life improvements to the UI based on requests from players.

Features:

 Added an in-game notebook
 Added search capability to name dropdowns
 Allow reordering of evidence by dragging thumbnails


Fixes/improvements:

 Added four new background music tracks
 Improved some more evidence and portraits
